why_ai: Data cleaning, joins and dashboards are screen work that AI analysts increasingly do directly.

why_ai: Demand grows with AI deployment as regulators require independent conformity audits.

why_ai: Signal-to-financials mapping is quantitative work AI can do; exclusive panel access gives partial protection.

why_ai: Survey-based maturity models and benchmark reports are easily produced by AI tooling.

why_digital: Survey data in and benchmark reports out, all online.

why_ai: Bulk labelling is being replaced by models; only expert graded evaluation adds some judgment.
why_clarity: Guidelines define tasks across millions of near-identical units, though expert judgments are harder to verify.
why_digital: Data in and labels out through online platforms with a global workforce.

why_ai: Classification models and metric definitions are exactly what LLM-based tooling automates.
why_clarity: Classifiers and lineage inference are measurable against customer schemas.
why_digital: Schemas in and software features out, built entirely in code.

why_ai: Acquisition decisions are high-stakes and relationship-led, though target screening is automatable.
why_clarity: Diligence models are standard, but deal outcomes show only after integration.
why_digital: Engagement data in and models out, with deals sourced through relationships.

why_ai: Certification credentials carry institutional weight, but body-of-knowledge writing is automatable.

why_ai: Catalogue curation and matching are automatable; cross-dataset identity linkage is the moat.

why_ai: Job status, row counts and quality thresholds are deterministic checks software already automates.

why_digital: Pipeline logs in and alerts out, entirely in software.

why_digital: EHR and claims data in and analytics out, all screen work.

why_ai: Enterprise buyers pay for the integrator's relationship and scale on AI transformation programmes.
why_clarity: Reference architectures codify methods, but programme success is judged slowly.
why_digital: Platform builds are screen work, with some on-site presence at enterprise clients.

why_clarity: OEE and quality analytics follow standard formulas reusable across plants.
why_digital: Historian and SCADA data in, with plant visits and regional relationships.

why_ai: Impact frameworks are ambiguous, but the analysis itself is screen work AI can assist heavily.

why_ai: Attorneys sign privacy assessments regulators expect, and new AI data uses keep raising demand.
why_clarity: Privacy regimes define required assessments and records of processing.
why_digital: Data flow documentation in and assessments out, done remotely.

why_ai: Templated recurring reports with updated data and narrative are a direct LLM substitution.
why_clarity: Identical report structures recur on schedules, with only narrative quality hard to grade.
why_digital: Data in and PDF reports out, distributed by email.

why_ai: Cultural trust from a bilingual consultant overcomes mistrust, though the analytics are standard.

why_digital: Business data in and dashboards out, with in-person training and community trust.

why_ai: Recruited longitudinal panels are a moat, but synthetic respondents threaten commodity fieldwork.

why_digital: Online panels in and weighted datasets out, sold globally.

why_ai: Generative models increasingly produce synthetic data directly, eroding the vendor's specialist role.
why_clarity: Fidelity and privacy metrics exist, but methods differ across vendors.
why_digital: Client data in and synthetic datasets out, fully software.
